Name: Great Catch (BETA)
Author: WayMee
Description:
[size=4]🎣 Great Catch — A New Fishing Experience in Stardew Valley![/size]
Tired of catching the same carp over and over again? Dreaming of new challenges and unexplored waters in your favorite game?
The [b]Great Catch[/b] mod completely transforms fishing in Stardew Valley into an exciting new adventure!

[size=4]✨ What’s Included?[/size][list]
[*][b]45 brand-new fish species[/b]
Dive into fishing like never before! Each of the 45 new fish comes with a unique, hand-crafted sprite that adds variety and life to your catches.[*][b]Rediscover familiar locations[/b]
New fish can be found in the waters of Cindersap Forest, the Mountains, the Beach, the Secret Woods, the western part of Ginger Island, and even the Sewers. Who knows what treasure you’ll reel in next?[*][b]A foundation for the future[/b]
This mod isn’t just about adding fish — it lays the groundwork for a complete fishing overhaul in the future.[/list][size=4]⚙️ Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Unzip the archive.

[*]Move the [code][CP] Great Catch[/code] folder into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] directory.

[*]Launch the game and enjoy your new catches!

[/list][size=4]🚀 Future Plans[/size]
[b]Great Catch[/b] is only the beginning of a much bigger journey! We are actively working on future updates that will include:
[list]
[*]Reworked fishing mechanics
[*]New locations to explore
[*]New NPCs and storylines
[*]Even more unique fish, items, and a full questline!
[/list]Stay tuned for updates — and thank you for playing!
Your feedback helps us make the mod better with every update. 💙🎣
Developer discord nickname: waymee
